description: Tenant-bound store role of the delegated-task trace and record partitions (libs/core/workforce/delegated-task-observability.ts). The delegation store assumes it (withExecutionContext / withExecutionContextAsync) for every tenant partition read and write — trace append, record write/read/listing, child-inbox queue I/O, background-completion notification queue (libs/core/mission/delegation-notifications.ts: <partition>/notifications.jsonl) append, read and claim — always bound to the delegation's tenant, so the grants resolve through ${KYBERION_TENANT} to that one tenant's active/shared/runtime/delegation-records/confidential/<tenant>/ partition. Tenant-bound (TENANT_BOUND_READER_ROLES): a caller with another active tenant cannot bind it, so a process bound to one tenant never reads another tenant's delegation instructions or results. The inter-process locks stay under the caller's role. No knowledge, mission, system partition, legacy observability or customer/ grant.
